prod_caption_cues.text: These roasted carrots are always the first thing gone from the table,
and the secret is the crunchy bit on top.
Rainbow carrots, roasted hot with olive oil, salt, and pomegranate molasses,
Garlic and flaked almonds fried golden, then chopped dates and capers, sweet, salty, crisp.
Thick yogurt with lemon zest, dill, and a spoon of tahini.
